scope.interaction: force one stale model-selection transport, recover with a fresh websocket ticket, retry, and persist the selected model

classification.reason: The same production connector rebuilt its RPC transport 50/50 times and recovered a deliberately closed live scope with a fresh ticket. Lynxtron only carried the renderer-to-main command; the stale RPC socket and recovery policy were owned by T3.

implementation.disconnectHandling: RpcClient.ConnectionHooks triggers an owned transport recovery before the next user command.
implementation.retryPolicy: Each recovery opens up to three fresh websocket-ticket attempts with bounded 250 ms and 500 ms backoff.
implementation.generationGuard: Superseded or disposed RPC scopes cannot install their client or emit a recovery.
implementation.mutationOrdering: Thread model mutations wait for an in-flight recovery instead of silently succeeding while the client is temporarily unavailable.

validation.productionBuild: pass with existing unsupported-property and import.meta warnings
